finding: The ceiling block width is five at n=513 with 128 ranks. For ranks 103-127, localStart exceeds n, and unsigned n-localStart underflows; min(colsPerRank,n-localStart) therefore incorrectly assigns five nonexistent columns instead of zero. generateLocalMatrix then reads B[j*n+k] for j>=n and writes col[j] beyond the intended column bounds. The gather-count construction repeats the same unsigned subtraction.
observed_failure: The job exits 139 with multiple rank segmentation faults. The common fault offset is main+0x3b5 (ELF address 0x9b25), a vector multiply with a memory operand, consistent with the invalid matrix-generation read. The paired r4 check passes in 12.092829 seconds; the failed execution does not time out.
interpretation: This is a pre-existing empty-partition memory defect, not scheduling contention. The original-to-effective source diff only changes maximum-rank timing reporting. Retain failed external validation without a retry.
investigation: Static source and binary inspection, original/effective timing diff, and retained validation output; no retry.
